comparison.objective: Clamp two aligned boards with a one-hand bar clamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Position opposing jaws, close and squeeze to force, then release without shifting boards.
comparison.success_condition: At least 20 N retained clamp force, aligned boards, clamp hanging independently and stable.
comparison.reason: Tests force-generating clamp engagement and retained preload, not transient impact fracture or fragment containment.
